value.rationale: A complete two-type generic silhouette classification and exact four-truncation-parameter invariance are established for arbitrary tetrahedra, not a lone numerical invariant. The coupling is pointwise for the same view of two different solids and transfers the known solid-angle probability without computing unrelated new statistics. This gives a natural structural description of random shadows throughout a nontrivial class of 12-vertex polytopes.
